note: FICTIONAL TEMPLATE ONLY, not generated footage or observations about a YouTube video

shots.story_purpose: Hook: an unexpected package falls into an empty train car
shots.camera: 35mm-ish low static wide with a motivated minor tilt
shots.action: Package slides and stops under a seat
shots.continuity: Empty car, night, rain outside, package begins center-left and ends by right bench
shots.sound: Wheels on tracks + package skids, no speech

shots.camera: 50mm-ish medium; held-off frame with slight operator reframe
shots.action: Person looks down, then reaches toward bench
shots.continuity: Person enters from left, package remains under right bench, same cool overhead car light

shots.camera: close insert from same axis, restrained push
shots.action: Red timer display reflects in character's eye, no invented readable signage
shots.continuity: Same package and geography; person remains crouched near right bench
shots.sound: Electrical chirp, train rattle ducks slightly

shots.story_purpose: Action: character drags package away from vent
shots.action: Two-hand grasp, weight transfer and fabric tension
shots.continuity: Package moves from right bench toward center aisle; no vanish/reappear
shots.sound: Shoe grip + coarse plastic drag + breath

shots.action: Eyes glance to emergency handle, breath catches
shots.continuity: Character crouched near aisle, same train and light, package now in aisle
shots.sound: Natural quiet whispered line with spatial car acoustics

shots.story_purpose: Payoff: chooses to open a window instead of pulling alarm
shots.camera: wide geographic return, gently reframe to window
shots.action: Character braces, reaches window, window starts to open
shots.continuity: Package stays in aisle, established train direction preserved
shots.sound: Handle rattle + air pressure + music resolves and stops
